strategies.name: Value + Momentum + Quality Multi-Factor
strategies.core_rule: Rank liquid stocks on valuation, intermediate-term momentum, and quality/profitability; buy the strongest combined scores and rebalance on a fixed schedule.
strategies.failure_modes: Factor crowding, value traps, momentum reversals, turnover and unintended sector bets.

strategies.name: Diversified Time-Series Momentum / Managed Futures
strategies.core_rule: Go long assets with positive medium-term own-price trends and short assets with negative trends across equity indexes, bonds, FX and commodities; volatility-scale positions.
strategies.failure_modes: Whipsaw in range-bound markets, sudden trend reversals, leverage and futures-roll costs.

strategies.name: Cross-Sectional Momentum
strategies.core_rule: Buy recent relative winners and underweight/short recent losers, usually skipping the most recent month to reduce reversal contamination.
strategies.failure_modes: Momentum crashes after sharp rebounds; high turnover and crowding.

strategies.name: Quality + Value
strategies.core_rule: Buy profitable, conservatively financed companies only when valuation is attractive relative to peers/history.
strategies.failure_modes: Can lag expensive growth-led markets; accounting comparability and cyclicality matter.

strategies.name: Risk-Parity Core + Trend Overlay
strategies.core_rule: Risk-balance major asset classes, then overlay trend signals to cut or reverse exposures when persistent downtrends appear.
strategies.failure_modes: Model risk, leverage, bond-equity correlation shifts, whipsaw.

strategies.name: Carry + Trend
strategies.core_rule: Harvest positive carry only when price trend is not strongly adverse; size by volatility and diversify across FX, bonds, commodities and credit.
strategies.failure_modes: Carry crashes during funding/liquidity stress; correlation spikes.

strategies.name: Low-Beta + Quality
strategies.core_rule: Favor low-beta/low-volatility companies with robust profitability and balance sheets; diversify by sector.
strategies.failure_modes: Can become rate-sensitive or valuation-expensive; leverage is sometimes needed for market-neutral BAB implementations.

strategies.name: Multi-Asset Value + Momentum
strategies.core_rule: Within asset classes, combine cheap-versus-expensive measures with relative/absolute momentum and diversify globally.
strategies.failure_modes: Signal definition differs by asset class; implementation and financing costs matter.

strategies.name: Gross-Profitability / Quality Premium
strategies.core_rule: Rank firms by gross profits-to-assets and related profitability measures; favor highly profitable firms, ideally with valuation controls.
strategies.failure_modes: Accounting distortions, sector biases, quality becoming overpriced.

strategies.name: Betting Against Beta (BAB)
strategies.core_rule: Go long lower-beta assets and short higher-beta assets, scaling each side toward comparable beta exposure.
strategies.failure_modes: Leverage/funding risk, shorting costs, model instability, crowding.

strategies.name: Post-Earnings-Announcement Drift (PEAD)
strategies.core_rule: After large earnings surprises, trade in the direction of the surprise when price/volume confirmation and liquidity are strong.
strategies.failure_modes: Gap risk, fast information incorporation, transaction costs, crowding.

strategies.name: Earnings-Revisions Momentum
strategies.core_rule: Buy stocks with broad upward analyst estimate revisions and improving forward earnings; avoid deteriorating revisions.
strategies.failure_modes: Consensus herding, stale estimates, sudden guidance reversals.

strategies.name: Dual Momentum
strategies.core_rule: Use relative momentum to select the strongest risky asset and absolute momentum to move defensive/cash when the winner has a negative trend.
strategies.failure_modes: Whipsaw, concentration, tax/turnover effects.

strategies.name: Crisis Trend / Defensive Managed Futures
strategies.core_rule: Run diversified trend signals with strict volatility targeting and enough short capability to profit from sustained Educational research only • No strategy guarantees profit or billionaire-level wealth • Page 7 Top 100 Trading Strategies | Research Handbook | 24 Sep 2026 equity, rate, FX or commodity declines.
strategies.failure_modes: No guarantee of crisis protection; abrupt V-shaped reversals can hurt.

strategies.name: Quality GARP
strategies.core_rule: Select high-ROIC, durable-growth firms only when growth- adjusted valuation is sensible; require positive earnings/price momentum.
strategies.failure_modes: Growth disappointments, narrative bias, valuation multiple compression.

strategies.name: Short-Term Reversal with Liquidity Filter
strategies.core_rule: Buy recent sharp losers and sell/avoid sharp winners only when the move appears liquidity-driven rather than information-driven.
strategies.failure_modes: Catching genuine news-driven moves; adverse selection; high costs.

strategies.name: Pairs Trading / Relative-Value Mean Reversion
strategies.core_rule: Match economically similar or historically co-moving securities; trade temporary spread divergence and exit on convergence or structural break.
strategies.failure_modes: Relationship breakdown, short borrow, transaction costs, crowded signals. Educational research only • No strategy guarantees profit or billionaire-level wealth • Page 8 Top 100 Trading Strategies | Research Handbook | 24 Sep 2026

strategies.name: Merger Arbitrage Basket
strategies.core_rule: After announced cash/stock deals, buy targets at a spread to consideration and hedge acquirer/market exposures where appropriate across a diversified basket.
strategies.failure_modes: Large left-tail losses on broken deals, legal/regulatory uncertainty, crowded trades.

strategies.name: Cash-Secured Index PutWrite
strategies.core_rule: Hold cash/T-bills and systematically sell fully collateralized broad-index puts under strict exposure limits.
strategies.failure_modes: Crash convexity, gap risk, volatility clustering; returns can resemble selling insurance.

strategies.name: Covered-Call / BuyWrite Overlay
strategies.core_rule: Own diversified equities and systematically sell calls on part of the exposure; use dynamic coverage when valuations/volatility are elevated.
strategies.failure_modes: Strong bull-market underperformance, downside remains substantial, tax/roll costs.

strategies.name: 12-Month Time-Series Momentum
strategies.core_rule: Use trailing 12-month excess return sign as a directional signal with monthly rebalance and volatility scaling.
strategies.failure_modes: Signal lag and reversal risk.

strategies.name: 6-Month Time-Series Momentum
strategies.core_rule: Use 6-month trend direction; combine with 12-month signal to reduce dependence on one lookback.
strategies.failure_modes: More whipsaw and turnover than slower trend.

strategies.name: Donchian Channel Breakout
strategies.core_rule: Enter on N-day highs/lows; trail exits with opposite-channel or volatility stop.
strategies.failure_modes: False breakouts and gap slippage.

strategies.name: Moving-Average Trend Filter
strategies.core_rule: Hold long when price is above a slow moving average; reduce, hedge or reverse when below; use multiple horizons.
strategies.failure_modes: Late exits/entries; sideways-market whipsaw. Educational research only • No strategy guarantees profit or billionaire-level wealth • Page 10 Top 100 Trading Strategies | Research Handbook | 24 Sep 2026

strategies.name: Volatility-Scaled Trend Following
strategies.core_rule: Apply trend signals but scale notional inversely to recent volatility; cap gross and single-market risk.
strategies.failure_modes: Volatility can jump faster than the estimator adjusts.

strategies.name: Trend + Pullback Entry
strategies.core_rule: Trade only in the direction of a higher-timeframe trend, entering after controlled pullbacks to support/mean rather than chasing extensions.
strategies.failure_modes: Pullback can become reversal; subjective support definitions if not systematized.

strategies.name: Volatility-Contraction Breakout
strategies.core_rule: Identify tight price ranges / declining realized volatility, then enter on range expansion with volume and trend confirmation.
strategies.failure_modes: News gaps, fake breakouts, parameter sensitivity.

strategies.name: 52-Week-High Momentum
strategies.core_rule: Favor stocks trading near their 52-week highs with strong breadth and liquidity; avoid parabolic/illiquid names.
strategies.failure_modes: Crowding, crash exposure, valuation blindness.

strategies.name: Residual Momentum
strategies.core_rule: Rank momentum after removing broad market/sector- factor components; buy residual winners.
strategies.failure_modes: Model instability, higher data/estimation burden.

strategies.name: Industry Momentum
strategies.core_rule: Overweight industries with strong medium-term relative returns; select quality leaders within winning industries.
strategies.failure_modes: Sector rotation can reverse abruptly.

strategies.name: Sector Rotation by Relative Strength
strategies.core_rule: Rank sectors on risk-adjusted momentum; allocate to leaders with a broad-market trend filter.
strategies.failure_modes: Concentration and rapid regime shifts.

strategies.name: Commodity Trend Basket
strategies.core_rule: Apply trend signals across energy, metals and agriculture with volatility targeting and position caps. Educational research only • No strategy guarantees profit or billionaire-level wealth • Page 12 Top 100 Trading Strategies | Research Handbook | 24 Sep 2026
strategies.failure_modes: Limit moves, roll costs, geopolitical gaps.

strategies.name: FX Trend Basket
strategies.core_rule: Trade liquid currency forwards/futures in direction of medium-term trends, diversified across pairs.
strategies.failure_modes: Central-bank intervention, funding costs, crowded USD exposures.

strategies.name: Rates/Bond Trend Basket
strategies.core_rule: Trade government bond futures using multi-horizon trend and volatility scaling.
strategies.failure_modes: Policy shocks, convexity effects, liquidity differences across contracts.

strategies.name: Economic-Trend Confirmation
strategies.core_rule: Combine price trend with persistent macro fundamentals (inflation, growth, policy) to require aligned direction before taking large positions.
strategies.failure_modes: Data revisions, lagging macro indicators, model complexity.

strategies.name: Classic Value (Book-to-Market)
strategies.core_rule: Buy diversified high book-to-market stocks, ideally with quality and momentum safeguards.
strategies.failure_modes: Intangible-heavy businesses weaken book value; value traps and long droughts.

strategies.name: Earnings-Yield Value
strategies.core_rule: Rank by earnings/price or normalized earnings yield relative to sector/history; avoid highly cyclical peak earnings.
strategies.failure_modes: Accounting quality and cyclicality.

strategies.name: Free-Cash-Flow Yield
strategies.core_rule: Favor firms with high sustainable FCF yield, strong conversion and manageable leverage.
strategies.failure_modes: Capex cycles, one-off working-capital distortions.

strategies.name: EV/EBITDA Value
strategies.core_rule: Compare enterprise-value multiples within industries; favor cheaper firms with stable margins and balance sheets.
strategies.failure_modes: Ignores capex intensity and working capital; sector Educational research only • No strategy guarantees profit or billionaire-level wealth • Page 14 Top 100 Trading Strategies | Research Handbook | 24 Sep 2026 comparability needed.

strategies.name: Shareholder Yield
strategies.core_rule: Rank by dividends + net buybacks + net debt reduction, combined with quality filters.
strategies.failure_modes: Buybacks can be poorly timed; leverage-financed repurchases.

strategies.name: Dividend Quality
strategies.core_rule: Prefer sustainable dividend growers with high coverage, stable cash flow and prudent payout ratios.
strategies.failure_modes: Rate sensitivity and dividend cuts.

strategies.name: Quality Minus Junk (Long-Biased)
strategies.core_rule: Overweight firms that are profitable, safe, growing and well managed; underweight weak-quality firms.
strategies.failure_modes: Quality can become expensive and crowded.

strategies.name: ROIC / Economic-Profit Quality
strategies.core_rule: Favor high and stable return-on-invested-capital firms with reinvestment runway and sensible valuation.
strategies.failure_modes: ROIC normalization is industry-specific; acquisition accounting can distort.

strategies.name: Low Accruals
strategies.core_rule: Prefer earnings backed by cash flows; avoid firms with unusually high accruals relative to assets/sales.
strategies.failure_modes: Data cleaning and industry norms matter.

strategies.name: Conservative Investment Factor
strategies.core_rule: Favor firms with restrained asset growth/investment relative to aggressive expanders, controlling for profitability.
strategies.failure_modes: May miss genuinely high-return growth opportunities.

strategies.name: Minimum-Variance Equity
strategies.core_rule: Optimize a diversified equity portfolio for lower forecast variance with constraints on sector and turnover.
strategies.failure_modes: Optimizer instability, concentration, factor crowding.

strategies.name: Low-Volatility Screen
strategies.core_rule: Select stocks with low realized volatility/beta and adequate liquidity; rebalance slowly. Educational research only • No strategy guarantees profit or billionaire-level wealth • Page 16 Top 100 Trading Strategies | Research Handbook | 24 Sep 2026
strategies.failure_modes: Can become expensive and rate-sensitive.

strategies.name: Quality + Low Volatility
strategies.core_rule: Select low-volatility stocks only if profitability, leverage and earnings stability also pass thresholds.
strategies.failure_modes: Can underperform speculative rallies.

strategies.name: Value + Low Volatility
strategies.core_rule: Buy relatively cheap low-volatility firms with quality floors.
strategies.failure_modes: May tilt heavily to mature sectors.

strategies.name: Quality + Momentum
strategies.core_rule: Own high-quality firms only when price and/or earnings momentum confirms; exit on sustained deterioration.
strategies.failure_modes: Can overpay for crowded winners; momentum crash risk.

strategies.name: FX Carry Basket
strategies.core_rule: Long higher-yielding currencies and short lower-yielding currencies with diversification and volatility caps.
strategies.failure_modes: Sharp deleveraging, funding crises and policy shifts.

strategies.name: FX Carry + Momentum Filter
strategies.core_rule: Take carry trades only when exchange-rate trend is not strongly against the position.
strategies.failure_modes: May exit late and re-enter after reversals.

strategies.name: Commodity Carry / Curve Roll
strategies.core_rule: Prefer commodity futures with favorable term-structure carry (e.g., backwardation) and avoid adverse roll, with trend confirmation.
strategies.failure_modes: Curve can change fast; storage/seasonality effects.

strategies.name: Bond Carry + Roll-Down
strategies.core_rule: Hold positions where yield-curve shape provides positive carry and roll-down, while hedging major duration risks when possible.
strategies.failure_modes: Rate shocks, curve regime change, leverage.

strategies.name: Credit Carry with Trend/Risk Filter
strategies.core_rule: Own diversified credit spread exposure when carry is attractive and macro/trend conditions are not deteriorating.
strategies.failure_modes: Gap/default risk, liquidity freezes, crowded exits.

strategies.name: Cross-Asset Carry
strategies.core_rule: Rank assets by carry within each class, long high-carry and short/underweight low-carry, risk-balanced across classes.
strategies.failure_modes: Shared exposure to recession/liquidity/volatility shocks.

strategies.name: Value + Carry
strategies.core_rule: Prefer assets that are both cheap relative to fundamentals/peers and offer positive carry.
strategies.failure_modes: Value can get cheaper; carry can mask tail risk.

strategies.name: Macro Regime Carry Allocation
strategies.core_rule: Scale carry down when volatility, funding stress and recession risk indicators rise; restore exposure in calmer regimes. Educational research only • No strategy guarantees profit or billionaire-level wealth • Page 19 Top 100 Trading Strategies | Research Handbook | 24 Sep 2026
strategies.failure_modes: Regime indicators can be late or overfit.

strategies.name: Yield-Curve Steepener/Flattener with Macro Confirmation
strategies.core_rule: Trade relative changes between short and long rates based on policy, inflation and growth divergence, with bounded DV01.
strategies.failure_modes: Policy surprises, convexity and leverage.

strategies.name: Global Macro Multi-Signal
strategies.core_rule: Combine trend, carry, valuation and macro surprise signals across liquid futures; allocate by risk budget rather than conviction alone.
strategies.failure_modes: Model conflict, over-complexity, hidden common exposures.

strategies.name: Cointegration Statistical Arbitrage
strategies.core_rule: Trade stationary residuals of cointegrated security baskets rather than simple price correlations.
strategies.failure_modes: Cointegration can break structurally; estimation error.

strategies.name: Sector-Neutral Mean Reversion
strategies.core_rule: Within each sector, buy abnormal short-term losers and short/underweight winners, keeping market and sector beta near neutral.
strategies.failure_modes: Adverse selection from real news; borrow/turnover costs.

strategies.name: Index Futures Cash-and-Carry Basis
strategies.core_rule: Trade deviations between index futures and fair value while hedging cash/index exposure.
strategies.failure_modes: Financing, dividends, execution latency, capital and shorting constraints.

strategies.name: Futures Calendar-Spread Relative Value
strategies.core_rule: Trade unusually wide/narrow spreads between contract maturities based on storage, financing and seasonal structure.
strategies.failure_modes: Delivery mechanics, liquidity and regime shifts.

strategies.name: ETF vs NAV / Basket Arbitrage
strategies.core_rule: Exploit discrepancies between ETF price and replicating basket/NAV using creations/redemptions where authorized.
strategies.failure_modes: Requires institutional access, inventory and fast execution.

strategies.name: ADR / Local-Share Relative Value
strategies.core_rule: Hedge equivalent listings across countries after adjusting FX, fees, taxes and fungibility.
strategies.failure_modes: Capital controls, settlement mismatch, borrow, corporate actions.

strategies.name: Dual-Class Share Spread
strategies.core_rule: Trade abnormal pricing gaps between share classes with similar economics after accounting for voting rights and liquidity.
strategies.failure_modes: Voting/control premiums may be persistent; borrow risk.

strategies.name: Closed-End Fund Discount Mean Reversion
strategies.core_rule: Buy unusually wide discounts and hedge broad asset exposure when discount mean reversion catalyst exists.
strategies.failure_modes: Discounts can persist for years; leverage and asset opacity.

strategies.name: Yield-Curve Butterfly Relative Value
strategies.core_rule: Trade a middle maturity against weighted short/long maturities to isolate curvature rather than outright duration.
strategies.failure_modes: Model/hedge errors and leverage.

strategies.name: Cross-Sectional Bond Relative Value
strategies.core_rule: Compare bonds from same issuer/sector after adjusting duration, liquidity and optionality; long cheap/short rich.
strategies.failure_modes: Hard-to-borrow bonds, liquidity shocks, model risk.

strategies.name: Short-Horizon Index Reversal
strategies.core_rule: Fade extreme broad-index moves only when breadth/flow indicators suggest temporary liquidity pressure rather than macro news.
strategies.failure_modes: Catastrophic if fading a genuine regime break.

strategies.name: VWAP/Anchored-Mean Reversion with Trend Filter
strategies.core_rule: Fade deviations from VWAP/anchored VWAP only when Educational research only • No strategy guarantees profit or billionaire-level wealth • Page 23 Top 100 Trading Strategies | Research Handbook | 24 Sep 2026 higher-timeframe trend is flat or supportive; avoid strong news days.
strategies.failure_modes: Execution costs, data snooping, strong-trend losses.

strategies.name: Merger Arbitrage with Deal-Quality Scoring
strategies.core_rule: Score deals on financing, regulatory risk, shareholder votes, antitrust, strategic logic and spread; size by break- loss severity.
strategies.failure_modes: Binary legal/regulatory risk and correlated deal breaks.

strategies.name: Spin-Off Special Situations
strategies.core_rule: Analyze parent/spin valuation, forced selling and management incentives; buy only when post-spin fundamentals and balance sheet are strong.
strategies.failure_modes: Poor disclosure, leverage dumped into spin, small-cap liquidity.

strategies.name: Index-Reconstitution Flow Trading
strategies.core_rule: Anticipate mechanical index additions/deletions and rebalance flows, but demand sufficient spread after costs.
strategies.failure_modes: Crowding has reduced edge; timing rules change.

strategies.name: Buyback Announcement + Quality Filter
strategies.core_rule: Favor meaningful repurchase authorizations from undervalued, cash-generative firms without leverage deterioration.
strategies.failure_modes: Announcements may not be executed; debt-funded buybacks.

strategies.name: Insider-Buying Confirmation
strategies.core_rule: Use legally disclosed open-market insider purchases as a secondary signal alongside valuation and quality—not as a standalone trigger.
strategies.failure_modes: 10b5-1/compensation complexity, small purchases, delayed filings.

strategies.name: Earnings Gap Continuation
strategies.core_rule: After a large earnings gap, continue in gap direction only with strong volume, positive revisions and no immediate reversal.
strategies.failure_modes: Gap exhaustion, already-priced news, overnight risk.

strategies.name: Guidance / Revision Acceleration
strategies.core_rule: Rank companies by acceleration in forward estimates, margins and guidance rather than absolute growth alone. Educational research only • No strategy guarantees profit or billionaire-level wealth • Page 25 Top 100 Trading Strategies | Research Handbook | 24 Sep 2026
strategies.failure_modes: Analyst herding and late-cycle extrapolation.

strategies.name: Special-Situations Basket
strategies.core_rule: Diversify across tender offers, restructurings, spin-offs, asset sales and recapitalizations with explicit catalyst dates.
strategies.failure_modes: Legal/document complexity and idiosyncratic tail events.

strategies.name: Distressed-to-Recovery Trend
strategies.core_rule: Only enter distressed recoveries after balance-sheet catalyst plus improving price trend/liquidity, rather than bottom-fishing purely on price.
strategies.failure_modes: Permanent impairment, dilution, bankruptcy priority issues.

strategies.name: Catalyst Value + Momentum
strategies.core_rule: Buy undervalued quality companies with an identifiable catalyst and positive price/earnings momentum.
strategies.failure_modes: Too restrictive can create concentration; catalyst failure.

strategies.name: Dynamic Covered Calls
strategies.core_rule: Vary call overwrite percentage/strike by implied volatility, trend and valuation instead of selling 100% ATM calls every month.
strategies.failure_modes: Complexity and timing risk; still exposed to equity downside.

strategies.name: Cash-Secured PutWrite with Trend Filter
strategies.core_rule: Sell index puts only when collateral is sufficient and trend/stress filters permit; reduce size when volatility/funding stress spikes.
strategies.failure_modes: Crash gaps can overwhelm filters; vol can jump overnight.

strategies.name: Put-Spread Premium Harvesting
strategies.core_rule: Sell a put and buy a farther OTM put to cap tail loss; size by maximum loss rather than premium received.
strategies.failure_modes: Frequent small gains can mask occasional full-spread losses.

strategies.name: Delta-Hedged Volatility Risk Premium
strategies.core_rule: Sell options where implied volatility materially exceeds forecast realized volatility and dynamically hedge delta. Educational research only • No strategy guarantees profit or billionaire-level wealth • Page 27 Top 100 Trading Strategies | Research Handbook | 24 Sep 2026
strategies.failure_modes: Gamma gaps, transaction costs, vol-of-vol and model error.

strategies.name: Index Dispersion Trading
strategies.core_rule: Trade index implied correlation versus single-stock volatility, hedging directional exposure.
strategies.failure_modes: Complex hedging, event concentration, transaction costs.

strategies.name: Volatility Term-Structure Relative Value
strategies.core_rule: Trade unusually steep/inverted implied-volatility term structures while limiting event exposure.
strategies.failure_modes: Term structure can remain dislocated; gap and vol-of-vol risk.

strategies.name: Skew Risk-Premium Spread
strategies.core_rule: Trade relative richness of downside skew using defined- risk spreads rather than naked short puts.
strategies.failure_modes: Tail events and structural shifts in skew demand.

strategies.name: Collar Overlay
strategies.core_rule: Own equities, buy downside puts and finance part of the cost by selling upside calls.
strategies.failure_modes: Hedging cost and capped upside; not necessarily alpha- generating.

strategies.name: Tail Hedge + Carry Portfolio
strategies.core_rule: Allocate most risk to diversified carry/value/quality strategies and a small explicit budget to convex crash hedges.
strategies.failure_modes: Tail hedges usually bleed; hedge sizing/timing is difficult.

strategies.name: Long-Gamma Around Known Catalysts
strategies.core_rule: Buy options only when expected realized move is plausibly underpriced relative to implied volatility and catalyst distribution.
strategies.failure_modes: Implied volatility is often expensive; theta decay; difficult forecasting.

strategies.name: Passive Market Making / Liquidity Provision
strategies.core_rule: Quote two-sided markets around fair value, earn spread/rebates and rapidly control inventory/adverse selection.
strategies.failure_modes: Requires infrastructure, latency, inventory models and can suffer badly in informed flow.

strategies.name: Order-Book Imbalance Scalping
strategies.core_rule: Use depth, queue and trade-imbalance signals to forecast very short-horizon price moves, with strict cost/latency models.
strategies.failure_modes: Edge decays quickly; data/latency costs; spoofing/noise.

strategies.name: Opening-Range Breakout + Regime Filters
strategies.core_rule: Trade break of a defined opening range only when gap, volume, breadth and higher-timeframe trend agree.
strategies.failure_modes: False breakouts, opening slippage, news reversals.

strategies.name: Intraday Mean Reversion After Exhaustion
strategies.core_rule: Fade extreme extensions only after exhaustion signals, declining momentum and defined invalidation; never average down blindly. Educational research only • No strategy guarantees profit or billionaire-level wealth • Page 30 Top 100 Trading Strategies | Research Handbook | 24 Sep 2026
strategies.failure_modes: Strong trend days can create repeated losses.

strategies.name: News-Momentum with Liquidity Gate
strategies.core_rule: Trade only material, machine-readable or clearly quantified news in direction of initial reaction, requiring liquidity and continuation.
strategies.failure_modes: Headline interpretation errors, latency disadvantage, reversals.

strategies.name: Ensemble of Trend + Value + Carry + Quality
strategies.core_rule: Run independent sleeves for trend, value, carry and quality; risk-balance them and cap shared exposures.
strategies.failure_modes: Correlations can rise in crises; governance and monitoring complexity.

strategies.name: Regime-Aware Multi-Strategy Allocation
strategies.core_rule: Allocate among trend, momentum, mean reversion and carry based on market volatility, dispersion, trend strength and liquidity—using simple, pre-registered rules.
strategies.failure_modes: High overfitting risk; regime labels can be unstable.

strategies.name: Risk-First Adaptive Ensemble
strategies.core_rule: Combine multiple validated strategies; volatility-target each; use max-drawdown, exposure, liquidity and correlation limits; deactivate signals that fail live validation thresholds.
strategies.failure_modes: Governance failure, hidden leverage, correlation spikes, strategy-selection bias.
